observations: Three photos show a black tufted sofa with gold-colored legs.
The sofa has a rounded back and armrests, with a quilted design on the back and seat.
The upholstery appears to be a dark fabric, possibly velvet or a similar material.
The gold legs are thin and tapered, visible at the base of the sofa.
No visible brand or model markings are present on the sofa in any photo.
The photos are taken in a well-lit indoor setting with tiled flooring.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'OLANIYI OLAMIDE' are overlaid on all photos.

claims.evidence: The photos show only one sofa, but the seller claims both 3-seater and 2-seater versions. No visual evidence confirms the presence of both.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The sofa may be damaged or have hidden wear not visible in the photos, such as stains, tears, or loose upholstery.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the seat, back, and armrests showing all sides and edges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged or worn, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The sofa may not be in working condition (e.g., broken springs, loose joints, or damaged legs).
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the sofa being pushed or shaken to test stability and cushioning.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly not working, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The sofa may be a replica or low-quality version, not the brand or model claimed.
risks.proof: Photo of the sofa's underside or back showing any brand labels or model numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic or unbranded, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the seat, back, and armrests showing all sides and edges.
Video or photo showing the sofa being pushed or shaken to test stability and cushioning.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
